title: Design System: Need Momentum Homepage Concepts

display.purpose: Hero statements only; short, tightly balanced, and dominant.

signal-display.purpose: Unbounded Variable for thick dimensional Signal headlines and particle-compatible display language.

headline.purpose: Major section turns and manifesto statements.

title.purpose: Service routes, principles, and compact narrative blocks.

body.purpose: Long-form explanation with generous line height and controlled measure.

control.purpose: Heavy action labels and directional links.

label.purpose: Uppercase bearings, status, metadata, and technical annotation.

map-phrase.purpose: Instrument Serif Italic only for the words on the Map. in the Orbital Growth Map hero.

shadows.name: header-atmosphere
shadows.purpose: Separates the Map glass header from the moving Earth scene.

shadows.name: yellow-signal
shadows.purpose: Ambient action glow for the primary audit button.

shadows.name: instrument-depth
shadows.purpose: Physical outer depth and internal blue energy for orbital instruments.

shadows.name: media-stack
shadows.purpose: Offsets real-work frames from clean editorial surfaces.

shadows.name: founder-float
shadows.purpose: Keeps the glass founder caption attached to, but legible over, the portrait.

shadows.name: final-action
shadows.purpose: Lifts the dark final audit action from the yellow conversion portal.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Default decelerating curve for lifts, reveals, routes, and active service states.

motion.name: route-shift
motion.purpose: Orbital route-card background and vertical motion.

motion.name: signal-state
motion.purpose: Kinetic service-card activation through opacity, scale, and color.

motion.name: particle-logo-cycle
motion.purpose: Particle-only Need Momentum M and wordmark assembly: free field, resolve near 4.7s, exact particle formation near 5.9s, hold, and disperse.

motion.name: service-auto-swipe
motion.purpose: Automatic Signal service progression while preserving drag, scroll snap, arrows, and keyboard interaction.

motion.name: atomic-orbit
motion.purpose: Three integrated footer orbit paths around the particle-built wordmark; never a detached logo badge.

motion.name: founder-bio-resolve
motion.purpose: Founder biography words scatter and resolve once on first entry, then remain fully legible without looping.

motion.name: orbit-spin
motion.purpose: Slow rotation for the outer Map instrument ring.

motion.name: map-drift
motion.purpose: Desktop-only travel across the Map real-work strip.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses automatic animation while retaining visible final compositions and control feedback.

narrative.overview:
Need Momentum is a live instrument for seeing how search, media, place, and action connect. The system combines cartographic precision with visible energy: midnight fields create concentration, blue and cyan establish direction, and signal yellow marks the decisive next move.

Its two expressions must stay distinct inside that shared world. **Orbital Growth Map** is spatial, measured, and celestial, using Earth, orbits, plotted routes, and glass instruments. **Kinetic Signal Field** is immediate, electrical, and cinematic, using particle currents, swipe chapters, image transitions, and energy condensation. Both feel ambitious and technical without becoming dashboards or generic sci-fi decoration.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast signal colors moving across midnight and clean light fields.
Square, instrument-grade interfaces balanced by true circular orbital devices.
Exact transparent brand artwork and real, source-verified company imagery.
Motion that explains connection, direction, assembly, or transition.
Signal hero identity formed only from particles, without a flat foreground logo or decorative glass bubbles.
Official Momentum 360 yellow-white-blue lockup sampled into a dedicated particle formation.
Dense spectacle at hero scale with restrained, readable content surfaces below.

rules.name: The Signal Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Yellow is reserved for primary action, live status, and decisive emphasis; blue carries the system; cyan annotates it.

rules.name: The Dark Field Rule
rules.body: Use midnight for immersive scenes and proof, then move to cool light surfaces when comprehension should outrank spectacle.

rules.name: The Serif Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif Italic is approved only for the Map phrase “on the Map.”; all other display language remains Archivo.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Large Archivo type stays tightly tracked and tightly led, while Manrope body copy retains generous line height for long-scroll readability.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur and translucency are permitted only when the surface overlays imagery, WebGL, moving light, or an active visual instrument.

rules.name: The Flat Foundation Rule
rules.body: Content structure comes from color fields, spacing, and borders; shadow is an event or a physical-layer cue, not default decoration.

rules.name: The Circle Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Use a circle only for orbit, location, playback, status, or signal behavior; never round a rectangular control merely to make it friendlier.

dos: Do preserve Orbital Growth Map and Kinetic Signal Field as visibly distinct expressions of the same connected system.
Do use the exact transparent Need Momentum logo without a backing plate, recolor, crop, or reconstruction.
Do keep the Signal hero M particle-built only, with no foreground logo image or glass bubbles.
Do sample public/assets/brand/momentum-360-logo.png for the spatial-media particle formation.
Do keep the footer wordmark inside integrated particle and atomic-orbit motion, without a detached badge.
Do preserve Mac blond/left and Sean dark-haired/right in every image, caption, order, and alt description.
Do use only solo founder portraits with two sourced biography paragraphs each on the Signal page.
Do use real, source-verified founder and company imagery at documentary scale.
Do let motion explain connection, direction, sequence, or transformation, then provide a stable reduced-motion state.
Do keep essential copy, navigation, and calls to action outside canvas rendering.
donts: Don't merge the Orbital Growth Map into the Kinetic Signal Field or flatten both concepts into one generic tech aesthetic.
Don't use Instrument Serif outside the single Map phrase “on the Map.”
Don't place glass on an empty decorative card or use blur without active visual material behind it.
Don't layer a flat logo over a particle-built identity or substitute Need Momentum artwork for Momentum 360.
Don't round rectangular controls or cards unless a documented image mask requires it.
Don't synthesize founder identity, swap founder positions, or reverse the blond and dark-haired mapping.
Don't use the combined founder award photograph in Signal or loop founder biography text after resolution.
Don't invent customer logos, metrics, testimonials, pricing, or conversion results.
